## Bring the technologies together

Choose a project that requires several skills from the course rather than repeating one isolated technique.

## Show the process

Use sketches, CAD, files, photographs, measurements, prototypes, and short explanations as evidence. The portfolio should show how the idea changed through repeated NICE cycles.
